ops.oldText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related, directly or indirectly, to the Services; or
ops.newText: 3. that arises out of Customer's breach of applicable law; or

input.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed our indemnity in Section 8.2(a)(3) so that we do not indemnify IBM, without limitation of liability, for any claim by a Services Recipient relating to IBM's own Services; our playbook limits the customer indemnity to Customer-provided Content and our breach of applicable law. We are content for IBM's IP indemnity in Section 8.1 to stand as drafted.
input.summary: Limit Customer's indemnity to Customer Content and Customer's breach of law by removing the open-ended Services Recipient limb.
